results.question: What is the minimum attendance I need in each course?
results.answer:
The university’s Attendance Policy states that **you must attend at least 75 % of the classes held in each course**. This requirement applies separately to every course you are enrolled in — high attendance in one subject cannot compensate for a shortfall in another [Attendance Policy §2].  

*Note:* Attendance percentages are calculated exactly (no rounding up), so even 74.9 % is considered below the requirement [Attendance Policy §2].

results.question: What is the lowest attendance that can be condoned?
results.answer: The policy allows condonation of attendance down to **65 %** (i.e., a shortage of up to 10 percentage points can be approved)【Attendance Policy §4】.

results.question: How soon after returning to classes must I apply for condonation?
results.answer: You must submit the condonation application **within 7 days of returning to classes**【Attendance Policy §4】.

results.question: For how many courses can attendance be condoned in one term?
results.answer:
The university’s policies do not set a specific limit on the number of courses for which attendance can be **condoned** in a term.  

- The **Examination Regulations** state that a student may sit the end‑term exam of a course if “attendance in that course is at least 75%, **or has been condoned under the Attendance Policy (minimum 65%)**”【14】.  
- The **Attendance Policy** itself only defines the 75 % requirement and how attendance is calculated; it does not mention any cap on how many courses can receive condonation【8】.

Therefore, any course in which you meet the condonation criteria (attendance ≥ 65 % and any other eligibility conditions) can be condoned, and there is no overall limit on the number of such courses in a term.

results.question: Within how many days must I report attendance that was recorded wrongly?
results.answer:
You should report any attendance that you think is incorrect **within 7 days of that class**. After that period, a correction can only be made with the Head of Department’s approval.  

**Citation:** Attendance Policy §5.2 – “A student who believes their attendance has been recorded incorrectly must report it to the course faculty within **seven days** of the class.”

results.question: How much does re-evaluation of an answer script cost?
results.answer: The fee for re‑evaluation of an end‑term answer script is **₹ 1,000 per course**【Examination Regulations §6】.

results.question: How many days do I have to apply for re-evaluation?
results.answer: You can apply for re‑evaluation **within seven days** of the declaration of the end‑term results. 【Examination Regulations §6】

results.question: What is the fee for a supplementary exam?
results.answer: The fee for a supplementary examination is **₹ 1,500 per course**【Examination Regulations §5】.

results.question: What is the minimum pass mark in a course?
results.answer: The minimum pass mark for any course is **40 out of 100 overall**, and you must also secure at least **30 % of the marks in the end‑term examination**【Examination Regulations §1】.

results.question: How late can I enter the exam hall after the exam starts?
results.answer:
You may enter the exam hall up to **30 minutes after the exam has started**. After that you will not be allowed to enter.  

**Citation:** Examination Regulations §3 (students cannot enter more than 30 minutes after the start)【15】

results.question: What happens if I am caught with my phone in the exam hall?
results.answer:
Possessing a mobile phone (or any smart device other than a permitted calculator) inside the examination hall is **treated as “unfair means.”** The incident will be handled under the Academic Integrity Policy.

**Consequences** (per the policy on penalties for unfair means):

| Type of exam | First offence | Repeated offence |
|--------------|---------------|------------------|
| Quiz / Mid‑term | Zero marks in that examination | Grade F in the course |
| End‑term exam | Grade F in the course | Suspension for one term |

So, if you are caught with a phone during a **quiz or mid‑term**, you will receive **zero marks** for that exam on the first offence. If it happens again, you will get a **grade F** for the whole course.  

If the phone is found during an **end‑term examination**, the first offence results in a **grade F** for the course, and a repeat offence can lead to **suspension for one term**.  

All penalties are recorded in your academic file and affect scholarship eligibility.  

**Citations**  
- Possession of a phone is “treated as unfair means” [Examination Regulations §3]  
- Unfair means are listed as academic misconduct [Academic Integrity Policy §3]  
- Penalties for unfair means in exams [Academic Integrity Policy §5]

results.question: How do I get my answer sheet rechecked after the results?
results.answer:
To get your answer sheet re‑checked (re‑evaluation) you need to follow these steps:

1. **Wait for the result declaration** – results are posted within 4 weeks after the last end‑term exam.  
2. **Apply within 7 days of the result** – submit a re‑evaluation request (usually through the exam office or the student portal).  
3. **Pay the fee** – Rs 1,000 per course for the re‑evaluation.  
4. **The re‑evaluation is done** – the new marks are final, whether they go up or down.

These steps are specified in the Examination Regulations §6.2 [Examination Regulations §6].

results.question: What is the late fee for paying tuition after the due date?
results.answer:
The university charges **₹ 100 per day** as a late fee on tuition fees paid after the due date, with the total late fee capped at **₹ 5,000**.  

*Citation:* [Fee Payment and Refund Policy §2]

results.question: How much is the end-term examination fee?
results.answer: The end‑term examination fee for each term is **₹ 3,500** per course【cite: "Fee Payment and Refund Policy §1"}

results.question: If I withdraw within 15 days of the term starting, how much of the tuition fee is refunded?
results.answer: If you withdraw **within 15 days of the term start**, you will receive a **refund of 80 % of the tuition fee** for the current term【Fee Payment and Refund Policy §5】.

results.question: Can I pay my tuition fee in instalments?
results.answer:
Yes. If you are facing financial difficulty you can apply to the Finance Office to pay your tuition fee in **two instalments** – 50 % by the due date and the remaining 50 % within 60 days 【Fee Payment and Refund Policy §3】.  

- The application must be submitted **before the tuition‑fee due date**.  
- No late fee is charged on an approved instalment that is paid on time.  
- **The end‑term examination fee cannot be paid in instalments**【Fee Payment and Refund Policy §3】.

results.question: What time do the hostel gates close?

results.question: How far in advance do I need to apply for hostel leave?
results.answer:
You need to apply for hostel leave **at least 24 hours in advance** on the student portal.  

**Citation:** Hostel Rules §4 ( “A student who will spend a night away from the hostel must apply for leave on the student portal at least 24 hours in advance.” )

results.question: What CGPA do I need for the merit-cum-means scholarship?
results.answer: You need a **CGPA of ≥ 8.0** to be eligible for the merit‑cum‑means scholarship [Scholarship Scheme §2].

results.question: What is the penalty for submitting an assignment late?
results.answer:
The penalty for a late assignment is:

- **Up to 48 hours after the deadline** – you may still submit, but you lose **10 % of the maximum marks for each 24‑hour period (or part of it)**.
- **More than 48 hours late** – the assignment receives **zero marks**.

**Source:** Academic Integrity Policy §2 (late‑submission rules)【Academic Integrity Policy §2】.

results.question: Exam dene ke liye kitni attendance chahiye?
results.answer:
**Exam dene ke liye attendance requirement**

- **75 % minimum attendance** in each course is required to be eligible for the end‑term exam.  
  - *Citation:* Attendance Policy §2 – “A student must attend at least 75 % of the classes held in each course …”【8】  
- If you have a shortage, you can still sit the exam **only if the shortage is condoned** under the Attendance Policy, in which case the minimum drops to **65 %**.  
  - *Citation:* Examination Regulations §2 – “attendance … is at least 75 %, or has been condoned … (minimum 65 %)”【14】

*Note:* Attendance is calculated as (classes attended ÷ classes held) and percentages are **not rounded up** (Attendance Policy §2.3). If your attendance falls below 75 % on the last teaching day, you will be debarred from that exam (Attendance Policy §3.1).

results.question: Agar exam hall mein phone pakda gaya toh kya hoga?
results.answer:
**Phone ko exam hall mein pakda jaane par usse “unfair means” maana jaata hai** — Examination Regulations §3.3 के अनुसार मोबाइल या किसी भी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक डिवाइस को बाहर रखना अनिवार्य है, और इसे रखने को अनियमित माना जाता है【15】. यह उल्लंघन Academic Integrity Policy §3 में भी “unfair means in examinations” के रूप में सूचीबद्ध है【3】.

### संभावित दंड (पहला और दोबारा उल्लंघन)

| परीक्षा का प्रकार | पहला उल्लंघन | दोबारा उल्लंघन |
|------------------|--------------|----------------|
| क्विज / मिड‑टर्म | उस परीक्षा में **शून्य अंक** | कोर्स में **ग्रेड F** |
| एंड‑टर्म परीक्षा | **ग्रेड F** (कोर्स में असफल) | **एक टर्म के लिए निलंबन** |
| अन्य (जैसे असाइनमेंट) | संबंधित घटक में शून्य अंक | अधिक कड़ी सजा (नीति में विस्तृत) |

(स्रोत: Academic Integrity Policy §5)【5】

**संक्षेप में:**  
- फोन पकड़े जाने पर इसे “unfair means” माना जाएगा।  
- पहली बार के लिए, यदि यह क्विज या मिड‑टर्म में हुआ तो शून्य अंक, एंड‑टर्म में ग्रेड F मिलेगा।  
- दोबारा होने पर ग्रेड F से लेकर एक टर्म निलंबन तक की सजा हो सकती है।  

सभी मामलों में यह सजा आपके अकादमिक फ़ाइल में दर्ज होगी और भविष्य में स्कॉलरशिप के लिए भी बाधा बन सकती है【5】.

results.question: What is the lowest attendance that can be condoned?

results.question: How late can I enter the exam hall after the exam starts?
results.answer:

results.question: What happens if I am caught with my phone in the exam hall?
results.answer:
Possessing a mobile phone (or any smart device) in the examination hall is classified as **unfair means**.  

- **Examination Regulations §3** states that “possession of a phone in the hall is treated as unfair means, whether or not it is used.”【Examination Regulations §3】  
- **Academic Integrity Policy §3** lists “unfair means in examinations: … possessing a mobile phone or smart device in the examination hall” as academic misconduct【Academic Integrity Policy §3】.  

Unfair‑means cases are dealt with under the Academic Integrity Policy, which can lead to disciplinary actions such as cancellation of the exam, a zero for the paper, and further academic penalties as per the university’s misconduct procedures.

results.question: How do I get my answer sheet rechecked after the results?
results.answer:
To have an end‑term answer script re‑evaluated you need to:

1. **Apply within 7 days of the result declaration** – the request must be made before the 7‑day window closes.  
2. **Pay the re‑evaluation fee** – Rs 1,000 per course.  
3. **Submit the application** – usually a re‑evaluation form (available at the Examination Office or on the student portal) together with the fee receipt.

After the office receives your request and fee, the script will be re‑checked and the new marks will be final (they may go up or down).  

*Reference:* Examination Regulations §6 – “A student may apply for re‑evaluation of an end‑term answer script within seven days of the declaration of results, on payment of Rs 1,000 per course.”【Examination Regulations §6】

results.question: Can I pay my tuition fee in instalments?

results.question: My DBMS attendance is low. Can it be condoned, and down to what minimum?
results.answer:
**Condonation for DBMS (CSE301)**  

- Yes, attendance shortfalls can be **condoned**.  
- The Dean of Academics may reduce the required attendance by **up to 10 percentage points**, but **never below 65 %** for a course【Attendance Policy §4】.  

Your current attendance for **Database Management Systems** is **68.89 %** (short of the 75 % requirement). Since this is above the 65 % floor, you are eligible to apply for condonation (e.g., medical certificate, university‑approved event, or family emergency).  

**Key points to remember**

| Requirement | Detail |
|-------------|--------|
| Minimum after condonation | **65 %** (cannot go lower) |
| Maximum reduction | **10 % points** (75 % → 65 %) |
| Application deadline | Within **7 days** of returning to classes【Attendance Policy §4】 |
| Courses per term | At most **two** courses can receive condonation【Attendance Policy §4】 |

If you have a valid reason, submit the application to the department office with the required supporting documents within the 7‑day window.

results.question: Agar main DBMS ki ek aur class miss karun toh kya main end-term de paunga?
results.answer:
**नहीं, एक और DBMS क्लास मिस करने से आप एन्ड‑टर्म परीक्षा नहीं दे पाएँगे** – और अभी भी दो चीज़ें पूरी नहीं हुई हैं:

| बात | वर्तमान स्थिति |
|-----|----------------|
| **अटेंडेंस** | 68.89 % (45 में से 31 क्लासें) – 6 क्लासें बाकी हैं। सभी 6 क्लासें अटेंड करने पर भी अधिकतम 72.55 % ही रहेगा, जो 75 % की न्यूनतम सीमा से नीचे है। इसलिए **कंडोनेशन** (कम से कम 65 % तक) की जरूरत है। |
| **फ़ी** | एन्ड‑टर्म परीक्षा फ़ी (₹3,500) अभी बकाया है, इसलिए एडमिट कार्ड जारी नहीं हुआ है। |

*यदि आप एक और क्लास मिस करेंगे तो आपका प्रतिशत और घट जाएगा, जिससे कंडोनेशन की संभावना और भी कम हो जाएगी।*  

**क्या आप परीक्षा दे सकते हैं?**  
- **कंडोनेशन** प्राप्त नहीं हुआ → नहीं।  
- **फ़ी** पूरी नहीं हुई → नहीं।  

**क्या कर सकते हैं?**  

1. **फ़ी का भुगतान** – ₹3,500 का एन्ड‑टर्म परीक्षा फ़ी आज़ तक चुकाएँ।  
2. **कंडोनेशन के लिए आवेदन** – यदि आप 65 % या उससे ऊपर (वर्तमान 68.89 %) हैं, तो मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट या अन्य मान्य कारण (स्पोर्ट्स, परिवारिक इमरजेंसी आदि) के साथ विभाग को आवेदन करें (7 दिन के भीतर)।  

**संदर्भ**  
- परीक्षा नियम (§2): “अटेंडेंस कम से कम 75 % या कंडोनेशन (न्यूनतम 65 %) होना चाहिए; फ़ी पूरी होनी चाहिए।”【Examination Regulations §2】  
- अटेंडेंस नीति (§3): “75 % से कम अटेंडेंस पर एन्ड‑टर्म परीक्षा से डिबार्ड किया जाता है।”【Attendance Policy §3】  
- अटेंडेंस नीति (§4): “कंडोनेशन 65 % तक की अनुमति देता है, अधिकतम 10 % पॉइंट की कमी।”【Attendance Policy §4】

**संक्षेप:** अभी आप परीक्षा नहीं दे सकते; एक और क्लास मिस करने से स्थिति और बिगड़ जाएगी। फ़ी चुकाएँ और कंडोनेशन के लिए तुरंत आवेदन करें।
